description: We are a team of developers and space enthusiasts building an AI-assisted Martian route planning and mission support system for the Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map challenge.
summary:
RED ROAD is an intelligent Mars surface route  planning and mission feasibility platform designed to help astronauts explore the Martian terrain more safely and efficiently. Using geospatial elevation and terrain data for Jezero Crater, the system creates an interactive 3D environment and identifies routes by balancing distance slope and  terrain hazards and scientific value 
Beyond finding a path, RED ROAD estimates astronaut walking time, energy expenditure, and oxygen consumption for both outbound and return journeys. It also evaluates the feasibility of returning from different points along the route and identifies a Point of Safe Return based on available oxygen and an emergency reserve.
By integrating terrain analysis, multi-criteria pathfinding, scientific target prioritization, and resource estimation, RED ROAD addresses a critical challenge of human Mars exploration: choosing not only where astronauts can go, but also whether they can safely return. It aims to support better-informed Marswalk planning and more effective scientific exploration.
details:
RED ROAD - Intelligent Mars Surface Exploration

RED ROAD is an intelligent platform designed to make exploring Mars safer and more efficient. It brings together terrain analysis, scientific route planning and astronaut resource estimation in one system Focusing on Jezero Crater

the platform uses real geospatial data to help plan exploration routes and identify important scientific locations and understand the resources needed to complete a mission safely

1-Understanding the Martian Terrain

RED ROAD turns elevation data from Mars into a detailed view of the Martian surface Using geospatial processing techniques, the system analyzes terrain elevation and slopes and potential hazards to identify areas that may affect astronaut movement and mission safety

It uses an eight directional A* pathfinding algorithm to find suitable routes across the terrain Instead of focusing only on the shortest distance the algorithm considers several factors such as safety, slope, distance and scientific value

This helps create routes that balance exploration goals with the challenges of the Martian environment.

2-Making Every Journey Scientifically Valuable

Exploration is about more than reaching a destination. Scientific discoveries are an important part of every Mars mission

RED ROAD includes a scientific target prioritization system that helps identify valuable locations across the terrain These targets are considered during route planning so that astronauts can explore areas of scientific interest while keeping the journey as safe and efficient as possible

3-Estimating Energy and Oxygen Requirements

One of the main features of RED ROAD is its astronaut bioenergetics module

It estimates walking speed and travel time, energy expenditure and oxygen consumption during the mission

The system uses Tobler's hiking function to estimate walking speed based on terrain slope and Minetti's metabolic cost model to estimate the energy required for movement These calculations are adapted to account for the lower gravity on Mars

The system evaluates both outbound and return journeys and considers elevation changes that may affect the astronaut's effort and resource consumption

4-Point of Safe Return

Safety does not stop when astronauts reach their destination. Returning safely is a major part of mission planning

RED ROAD introduces the Point of Safe Return feature. It checks whether the astronaut has enough oxygen remaining to complete the return journey while keeping an emergency reserve

The system also evaluates return feasibility from different points along the outbound route. This helps identify the points where continuing the mission may become unsafe and supports better decisions about when an astronaut should turn back

5-Interactive 3D Exploration

RED ROAD provides an interactive 3D environment built with Three.js. Users can explore Jezero Crater, view terrain features and visualize planned routes directly on the Martian landscape

This makes complex terrain information easier to understand and gives users a clearer picture of how the selected route interacts with the surrounding environment

6-AI Mission Copilot

To make the platform easier to use, RED ROAD includes an AI Mission Copilot powered by the Google Gemini API

The copilot allows users to interact with mission-planning features through natural language requests. It helps connect users with the system's available functions and makes the planning process more accessible

7-Technologies and Development

RED ROAD was developed using a combination of technologies for application development, geospatial analysis and intelligent route planning.

Frontend: TypeScript, Vite and Three.js for the user interface and 3D visualization.

Backend: TypeScript and NestJS for application logic and mission-planning services.

Geospatial Processing: Python, Rasterio and NumPy for processing elevation data and analyzing terrain

Pathfinding: Eight-directional A* for multi-criteria route planning, with Dijkstra used as a reference algorithm

AI Integration: Google Gemini API for the AI Mission Copilot.

The project also went through automated backend and frontend testing, build validation and checks covering route planning, resource estimation and safe-return calculations

8-Innovation and Expected Impact

What makes RED ROAD different is the way it connects several important parts of Mars exploration in one platform. It combines terrain intelligence, scientific target selection, route optimization, astronaut energy estimation and oxygen management

Instead of treating route planning as a simple navigation problem, RED ROAD considers the entire mission and the challenges astronauts may face along the way

Our goal is to support safer and smarter Mars exploration by helping astronauts make better decisions, use their available resources more efficiently and reach valuable scientific locations while keeping a safe return in mind
